desc_en: Backlit film for lightboxes: rich, even colour under backlighting, for retail and airport lightboxes, slim and fabric-frame lightboxes and shopfront signs. Common types available; specifications confirmed per enquiry.
desc_zh: 灯箱片（背光灯片）：背打光后色彩饱满均匀，用于商场、机场灯箱、超薄灯箱、卡布灯箱与门头灯箱。常见类型均可做，规格按询价确认。

applications: Retail, airport and transit lightbox advertising
Slim lightboxes and fabric-frame (soft film) lightboxes
detail_en.artwork: Please provide print-ready artwork, the visible frame dimensions, quantity and destination. File dimensions and bleed can be checked before production.
detail_en.brief: Please specify the lightbox type, graphic size, quantity, any installation support needed and the destination.
detail_en.caveat: Film type, width and price are confirmed for the specific lightbox and order; no list prices are published.
delivery: Production and dispatch timing confirmed per order
Sea freight to Australian main ports is around 40 days as a reference
highlights: Common types available: backlit film, soft-film lightbox media and more
Produced and trimmed to the actual frame size
Types, widths and prices confirmed per enquiry
detail_en.lead: Lightbox graphics live or die by their backlighting: even translucency and rich colour matter most. The film type is matched to the lightbox — slim, fabric-frame, free-standing or shopfront — and produced to the actual frame size.

applications: 商场与机场、地铁灯箱广告
超薄灯箱与卡布灯箱（软膜）
detail_zh.artwork: 请提供印刷文件、灯箱内框尺寸（可视画面尺寸）、数量及收货地址。生产前可核对文件尺寸和出血设置。
detail_zh.brief: 请提供灯箱类型、画面尺寸、数量、是否含安装配合及收货城市。
detail_zh.caveat: 灯箱片类型、幅宽与价格按具体灯箱和订单确认，不预设标价。
delivery: 国内订单多数一天做好，配送时效按收货城市在确认订单时写明
西安同城专车配送，时效见西安本地服务页
highlights: 常见类型均可做：背喷灯片、软膜灯箱片等
背光下色彩饱满、画面均匀
按灯箱实际尺寸裁切制作
类型、幅宽与价格按询价确认
detail_zh.lead: 灯箱画面靠背光出效果：透光均匀、色彩饱满是关键。按灯箱类型（超薄灯箱、卡布灯箱、立柱灯箱、门头灯箱）选对应的灯箱片类型，再按实际尺寸制作画面。

seo_description_en: Backlit film and soft-film lightbox graphics with rich, even colour under backlighting, for retail, airport and transit lightboxes. Types, widths and prices confirmed per enquiry.
seo_description_zh: 灯箱片定制与印刷：背喷灯片、软膜灯箱片等常见类型均可做，背光下色彩饱满均匀，适用于商场、机场、地铁灯箱与门头招牌。面向广告公司与制作商，多数订单一天做好，幅宽与价格按询价确认。
